notes.title: Join the testing of Roman Conquest: Rise to Power
notes.content:
Open testing begins in the long-awaited game "Roman Conquest: Rise to Power"! You will be able to help make the gameplay better and leave your part in the creation of the game. With every comment, the game gets closer to full release!

New opportunities will open up for you: lead your own army, become a real strategist, learn about military affairs, capture territories - and all this in one game. Immerse yourself in the world of the era of the Roman Empire.

Start conquering and improving your game with us!

Stay with us.
Sincerely, LOMS Studio team.
